name: Gravity Train (Theoretical/Rumored)
description: A rumored transit system in the deepest levels of the Underworld that uses gravity itself as propulsion — sealed tunnels bored in parabolic arcs through the earth, where a vehicle drops into one end, accelerates under gravity to tremendous speed at the lowest point, and decelerates as it climbs to the exit. No power required. No engine. Just physics. Multiple Underworld explorers have reported finding smooth, sealed tunnels that arc downward at impossible angles. No one has found a vehicle. No one has been brave enough to enter a tunnel. The math says these tunnels could transit the entire city in minutes.
range: Tunnel-dependent. Could span the entire city.
autonomy: Fully passive — gravity is the engine
common_usage: Unknown. If real, potentially the fastest transit system in Meridian 88 — built by someone who understood the earth better than anyone alive.
story_hooks: An explorer enters a gravity tunnel and emerges on the other side of the city in minutes — but they're not sure it was just physics that moved them
The gravity tunnels converge at a single point deep beneath the city center, and that point is occupied
